view.actModeTitleV2: Act mode: CaddyAI can make changes and use tools. The Ask/YOLO switch sets what needs your approval.
view.emptySubtitle: Messages are stored locally and encrypted at rest
view.emptyFolderContext: AI can read and create entities in "{{name}}"
view.selectThread: Select a thread to view the conversation
view.extensionRequired: Browser extension or team server connection required
view.deleteThreadMessage: This chat thread will be moved to trash. Are you sure?
view.deleteFolderMessage: This investigation and its organization will be removed. Threads inside will be moved to the top level.
view.rewindMessage: This will delete {{count}} message(s) after this point. This cannot be undone. Use Branch instead to preserve the full history.
view.restoreMessage: This will undo the AI's changes — created entities will be deleted and modified entities will be reverted to their previous state. This cannot be undone.
view.switchedToActV2: Switched to Act mode. The Ask/YOLO switch sets what needs your approval.
view.switchedToActMessageV2: Switched to **Act mode**. Send "execute the plan" to run the proposed actions, or continue the conversation. The Ask/YOLO switch sets which actions need your approval.
view.errorCreateThread: Failed to create chat thread. Try refreshing the page.
view.errorNoLocalEndpoint: No Local LLM endpoint configured. Add it in Settings → AI/LLM.
view.errorNoApiKey: No {{provider}} API key configured. Add an API key or local LLM endpoint in Settings → AI/LLM.
view.noApiKeysConfigured: No API keys configured — add one in Settings → AI/LLM
view.onboardingStep1Desc: Go to Settings > CaddyAI / LLM and add an API key for at least one provider or configure a local LLM endpoint.
view.onboardingStep2Desc: CaddyAI requires the ThreatCaddy browser extension to proxy API requests.
view.onboardingStep3Desc: In the extension popup, enable "Allow CaddyAI" for AI provider access and "Allow URL fetching" for the /fetch tool.

mode.planTitleV2: Plan mode: CaddyAI only reads and describes anything else as a plan. In an investigation it reads only that investigation; outside any investigation it can read all of them.
mode.switchedToPlanV2: Switched to Plan mode. CaddyAI only reads and describes anything else as a plan.
mode.yoloOnTitleV2: YOLO is on: changes and built-in vendor lookups run without asking. Web pages, skills, other integrations, and changes to other investigations or to agents still need your approval, as does reading other investigations from an investigation that can sync.
mode.yoloOffTitleV2: CaddyAI asks before each change, web page, vendor lookup, skill or other integration, and before reading other investigations from an investigation that can sync. Click to turn on YOLO: changes and built-in vendor lookups then run without asking, except changes to other investigations or to agents.

flag.untrustedHost: Not one of the built-in reference sites.
flag.urlCarriesData: The address is long enough to carry investigation data.
flag.hostIsIoc: This site is an IOC in this investigation. Visiting it can alert the attacker.
flag.harvested: This call was taken from the reply text rather than sent as a tool call, so injected content may have produced it.
flag.readForeign: Earlier in this reply CaddyAI read another investigation. This action may carry that data.

input.submitFailed: The message could not finish sending. Uncommitted text and images have been kept; check the thread before retrying.
input.memoryDrafts: Unsent chat drafts are kept only in this tab’s memory, including hidden threads. Send or discard them and wait for pending sends before switching workspaces; closing or reloading can lose them.
input.discardAllDraftsConfirm: Discard unsent text and images from every chat thread in this workspace and cancel pending image reads? Saved messages will not be changed. A send already in progress must still finish and may save its message. This cannot be undone.

draftError.length: A draft can contain at most 200,000 characters. The previous draft has been kept; shorten or split the message.
draftError.total: Unsent chat drafts can contain at most 1,000,000 characters in total. Send or discard other drafts first; the previous draft has been kept.

imageError.busy: Wait for the current image batch to finish. Your draft has been kept.
imageError.count: Attach at most 4 images per message. Your draft and earlier images have been kept.
imageError.type: Choose PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP images. Your draft and earlier images have been kept.
imageError.size: Each image must be 5 MiB or smaller. Your draft and earlier images have been kept.
imageError.total: Images must total 10 MiB or less per message. Your draft and earlier images have been kept.
imageError.global: Unsent chat drafts can hold at most 16 images and 20 MiB of image data in total, including reads in progress. Send or discard other drafts first; earlier images have been kept.
imageError.read: An image could not be read. The new batch was not attached; your draft and earlier images have been kept. Try selecting it again.
